defs.def: any of the parts into which sth is divided 部分；部门

ex.s: Volunteers under the age of 18 must have the parent/guardian approval section signed.
ex.t: 未满18岁的志愿者必须由家长/监护人签字批准。

ex.s: Paul Beer, head of rhino section at Port Lympne, said: “Obviously we're all absolutely delighted to welcome another calf to our black rhino family.
ex.t: 波特·林普恩犀牛部门主管保罗·比尔说："显然我们都非常高兴欢迎另一头小犀牛加入我们的黑犀牛家族。

ex.s: At the information desk at the entrance, I asked a lady where the shoe section was.
ex.t: 在入口处的咨询台，我问一位女士鞋区在哪里。

ex.s: Talk about another phenomenon of the global village using the expressions in this section.] Now think about any difficulties you encountered during your discussion and what you did to overcome them.
ex.t: 用这一部分的表达方式谈谈地球村的另一个现象。] 现在想想你在讨论中遇到的任何困难以及你是如何克服它们的。

ex.s: Have the sales section go first.

defs.def: a separate part of a structure from which the whole can be put together 部件；散件
a separate part of a document, book, etc. 节；款；项；段；部分

ex.s: Directions: In Section A, you will hear ten short conversations between two speakers.
ex.t: 说明：在A部分，你将听到两段说话者之间的十段简短对话。

ex.s: Appearance Personality Now give feedback and talk about whether you have used the words in this section properly in your speech.
ex.t: 外观个性 现在提供反馈，并谈论你是否在演讲中正确使用本节中的单词。

ex.s: Directions: In Section B you will hear two short passages, and one longer conversation ,after each passage.
ex.t: 说明：在B部分，你将听到两篇短文和一段较长的对话，每篇短文之后都有相应的问题。

ex.s: Then, when you use one section,   64   other stays fresh.
ex.t: 然后，当你使用一节，其他64保持新鲜。

ex.s: Perseverance Integrity Innovation Expertise Now comment on each other’s performances in using the words and expressions in this section.
ex.t: 毅力、正直、创新、专长。现在用本节中的词和表达评论彼此的表演。

defs.def: a separate group within a larger group of people 阶层；界；组
a department in an organization, institution, etc. 部门；处；科；股；组
a district of a town, city or county 区；地区；地段

ex.s: The rhino section will be open to the public.
A spotlight lights up only one section of a stage; similarly,"spotsound" creates a circle of sound in on targeted area.
ex.t: 聚光灯只照亮舞台上的一个区域；类似地，“spotsound”在目标区域制造一个声音圈。

defs.def: a measure of land, equal to one square mile （土地单位）一平方英里
a drawing or diagram of sth as it would look if it were cut from top to bottom or from one side to the other 剖面图；断面图
the act of cutting or separating sth in an operation 切开；切断
a very thin flat piece cut from body tissue to be looked at under a microscope （供显微镜下观察的）切片
to divide body tissue by cutting 切开；切断
to cut animal or plant tissue into thin slices in order to look at it under a microscope 做（动物或植物组织的）切片
to officially order a mentally ill person to go and receive treatment in a psychiatric hospital, using a law that can force them to stay there until they are successfully treated （依法令精神病人）强制入院治疗
